title: SM AC9C
text: Discrete-time or continuous-time synchronous machine AC9C excitation system including an automatic voltage regulator and an exciter, 10 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} sets the initial output voltage, {Initial terminal voltage, Vt0 (pu)}, {Initial terminal current, It0 (pu)}, {Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} sets the compensation resistance, {Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} sets the compensation reactance, {Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} sets the regulator time constant, {Voltage regulator proportional gain, K_PR (pu)} sets the proportional gain of the voltage regulator, {Voltage regulator integral gain, K_IR (pu/s)} sets the integral gain of the voltage regulator, {Voltage regulator derivative gain, K_DR (pu.s)} sets the derivative gain of the voltage regulator, {Lag time constant for derivative channel of PID controller, T_DR (s)} sets the lag time constant for PID derivative, {Maximum voltage regulator output, V_PIDmax (pu)} sets the maximum output of PID regulator, {Minimum voltage regulator output, V_PIDmin (pu)} sets the minimum output of PID regulator, {Field current regulator proportional gain, K_PA (pu)} sets the proportional gain of the field current, {Field current regulator integral gain, K_IA (pu/s)} sets the integral gain of the field current, {Maximum current regulator output, V_Amax (pu)}, {Minimum current regulator output, V_Amin (pu)}, {Controlled rectifier bridge equivalent gain, K_A (pu)} sets the rectifier bridge gain, {Controlled rectifier bridge equivalent time constant, T_A (s)} sets the rectifier bridge time constant, {Maximum rectifier bridge output, V_Rmax (pu)} sets the upper limit of the rectifier bridge output, {Minimum rectifier bridge output, V_Rmin (pu)} sets the lower limit of the rectifier bridge output, {Exciter field current feedback gain, K_F (pu)}, {Field current feedback time constant, T_F (s)} sets the feedback time constant, {Free wheel equivalent feedback gain, K_FW (pu)} sets the free wheel feedback gain, {Maximum free wheel feedback, V_FWmax (pu)} sets the upper limit of the free wheel feedback, {Minimum free wheel feedback, V_FWmin (pu)} sets the lower limit of the free wheel feedback, {Power stage type selector, S_CT} sets the option to select power stage type Thyristor, {Voltage limit, V_lim1 (pu)} sets the first automatic voltage regulator limit, {Voltage limit, V_lim2 (pu)} sets the second automatic voltage regulator limit, {Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} sets the oEL input location, {Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} sets the uEL input location, {Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} sets the sCL input location, {Exciter field proportional constant, K_E (pu)} sets the exciter field gain, {Exciter field time constant, T_E (s)}, {Diode bridge loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C (pu)}, {Demagnetizing factor, function of exciter alternator reactances, K_D (pu)} sets the demagnetization factor, {Exciter output voltage for saturation factor S_E(E_1), E_1 (pu)} sets the first saturation output voltage, {Exciter saturation factor at exciter output voltage E_1, S_E(E_1) (1)} sets the first saturation lookup voltage, {Exciter output voltage for saturation factor S_E(E_2), E_2 (pu)} sets the second saturation output voltage, {Exciter saturation factor at exciter output voltage E_2, S_E(E_2) (1)} sets the second saturation lookup voltage, {Exciter field current limit, V_FEmax (pu)} sets the exciter upper limit, {Minimum exciter output limit, V_Emin (pu)} sets the exciter lower limit, {Potential circuit gain coefficient, K_P (pu)}, {Potential circuit phase angle (degrees)}, {Compound circuit (current) gain coefficient, K_I (pu)} sets the compound circuit current gain coefficient, {Reactance associated with potential source, X_L (pu)}, {Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C1 (pu)}, {Power source selector SW1} sets the power source selector Position A: power source derived from terminal, {Maximum available exciter field voltage, V_B1max (pu)}, {Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C2 (pu)}, {Compound circuit (current) gain coefficient, K_I2 (pu)} sets the compound circuit current gain coefficient and {Maximum available exciter field voltage, V_B2max (pu)}. Values come from the instance.
